[2025-07-08 09:26:32] INFO client: Starting event stream topics=[head] [2025-07-08 09:26:32] INFO Listening to Beacon API events topics=head [2025-07-08 09:26:32] FATAL client: Failed to update proposer settings error=HTTP request unsuccessful (500: UNHANDLED_ERROR: UnableToReadSlot) ``` i think this must be something pregenesis or something at start up kurtosis setup to reproduce ``` participants: - el_type: geth el_image: ethereum/client-go:latest cl_type: lighthouse cl_image: sigp/lighthouse:latest-unstable vc_type: prysm vc_image: gcr.io/prysmaticlabs/prysm/validator:latest count: 2 network_params: genesis_delay: 120 min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1 shard_committee_period: 1 num_validator_keys_per_node: 250 churn_limit_quotient: 16 additional_services: - assertoor snooper_enabled: false disable_peer_scoring: true assertoor_params: image: "ethpandaops/assertoor:master" run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor-test/74a5f7c099c9f856bdca2117f6edf6e39e73cab5/assertoor-tests/block-proposal-check.yaml ``` it could also be our call itself (I'm redesigning some parts so maybe it'll get fixed then) but probably shouldn't be getting a 500 error, maybe like a 400 error or something if you refuse it keep getting this error with the kurtosis config. which endpoint is this btw? you gotta look out for the container ( it disappears after a while not starting) you'll see when you open it up that it's the error I posted above to me it looks like /eth/v1/validator/duties/attester/1 attester duties for next epoch, and lighthouse is throwing HTTP request unsuccessful (500: UNHANDLED_ERROR: UnableToReadSlot) ohh yeah sorry i see it now. seems like we handle the pre-genesis case for proposer duties but not for attester duties. i'm not sure why, i'll check

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content:
i think this must be something pregenesis or something at start up
kurtosis setup to reproduce
```
participants:
  - el_type: geth
    el_image: ethereum/client-go:latest
    cl_type: lighthouse
    cl_image: sigp/lighthouse:latest-unstable
    vc_type: prysm
    vc_image: gcr.io/prysmaticlabs/prysm/validator:latest
    count: 2
network_params:
  genesis_delay: 120
  min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1
  shard_committee_period: 1
  num_validator_keys_per_node: 250
  churn_limit_quotient: 16
additional_services:
  - assertoor
snooper_enabled: false
disable_peer_scoring: true
assertoor_params:
  image: "ethpandaops/assertoor:master"
  run_stability_check: false
  run_block_proposal_check: false
  tests:
    - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor-test/74a5f7c099c9f856bdca2117f6edf6e39e73cab5/assertoor-tests/block-proposal-check.yaml
```
